race.description: Win Network Port Macquarie Cup Prelude (Bm82) Hcp
race.comment: HIBIKI HARMONY (2) has been mixing in Open company and her latest Tuncurry sixth was only two and a half lengths from Dubai Warrior, so this Benchmark 82 looks a more suitable target if the extra ground does not test her. CASINO BEAR (1) resumes from eight months off and carries 63kg, yet his Randwick BM88 fourth two back reads strongly for this grade and his Port Macquarie record keeps him right in the discussion. CREATIVE RIGHTEOUS (5) is the fit, honest danger after a nose defeat at Taree, though he must turn the tables and prove himself at 1808m. PELEVECCHIO (6) hasn't threatened in two but is much better suited stepping out over further. Watch for her charging late.
